Generated Narrative: CodeSystem TrustDemoVerificationFailureReason

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/trust-demo/CodeSystem/TrustDemoVerificationFailureReason defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
BadPrefix Bad prefixThe text does not start with the HC1: prefix.
UnsupportedContextVersion Unsupported context versionThe context identifier names a version the verifier does not support.
Base45Invalid Base45 invalidThe text is not valid Base45.
InflateFailed Inflate failedThe compressed bytes do not decompress.
LimitExceeded Limit exceededA decode limit (size or depth) was exceeded.
CoseMalformed COSE malformedThe bytes are not a well-formed COSE_Sign1.
HeaderInvalid Header invalidA COSE header is missing or not as required.
UnsupportedAlgorithm Unsupported algorithmThe signature algorithm is not one the verifier accepts.
KidNotFound Key not foundNo certificate on the verifier's copy of the trust list has the kid (STT-VER-006).
SignatureInvalid Signature invalidThe signature does not verify with any certificate with the kid.
KeyUsageMismatch Key usage mismatchThe signer's certificate may not sign this kind of certificate.
Expired ExpiredThe certificate's expiry has passed.
NotYetValid Not yet validThe certificate's issued-at time is in the future.
HcertMissing HCERT missingThe claim set has no hcert claim.
MultipleSubclaims Multiple subclaimsThe hcert claim has more subclaims than the verifier accepts.
PayloadInvalid Payload invalidThe payload does not conform to its logical model.

name: TrustDemoVerificationFailureReason
title: Verification failure reasons
description: The closed set of reasons a DVC fails verification, shared by the Kotlin and Rust HCERT libraries (STT-VER-008).
